snippet.title: Animal Life: Africa Longplay [NDS] [No-Com]
snippet.description:
Educational game about animals living in Africa
Minigames aren't necessary but you have to do all animals' minigames on Perfect to beat the game
Have Fun :D

00:00 Beginning
00:16 Cheetah
03:05 Camel
05:14 Zebra
07:45 Animal Race (my hand hurts after playing this minigame)
08:55 Elephant
10:41 Munch (Pac-Man like Minigame)
11:25 Maths
11:55 Lion
14:19 Ending + Credits
